llms.body:
# Verizon
> Verizon is a leading provider of technology, communication, information and entertainment products and services to consumers, businesses and government agencies. We power and empower how people live, work and play through America's most reliable 5G network and comprehensive suite of wireless, internet, TV, and business solutions.
## Consumer Group
- [smartphones](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/): Verizon's full range of smartphones, compare models, and take advantage of various promotional offers. It's a one-stop-shop for anyone looking to buy a new phone through Verizon's network.
- [accessories](https://www.verizon.com/products/): Provides information on various accessory types like Cases, Chargers, Audio, Gaming , wearable tech and home.
- [plans](https://www.verizon.com/plans/unlimited/): Variety of plans offered by Verizon, which is also called as myPlan
- [5G Home](https://www.verizon.com/home/internet/): Information about Verizon's 5G network and consumer solutions
- [Deals](https://www.verizon.com/deals/): Variety of deals associated to smartphones, connected-devices, tablets and many more
- [Switch to Verizon](https://www.verizon.com/switch-to-verizon/): Provides information on how to switch to verizon from other carriers
## Business Group
- [Wireless](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/devices-services/wireless/): Information about business wireless plans and devices including 5G connectivity solutions
- [Internet](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/internet-tv-voice/internet/): Details on Fios, LTE, and 5G internet solutions for businesses
- [5G](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/5g/): Information about Verizon's 5G network and business solutions
- [Security](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/security-compliance/cyber-security-services/): Overview of Verizon's cybersecurity services and compliance solutions
- [Internet of Things (IoT)](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/iot-solutions/): Information on Verizon's IoT platform and connected device solutions
- [Fleet Management](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/fleet-management/): Vehicle tracking and fleet optimization solutions
- [Voice & Collaboration](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/voice-collaboration/): Business communication and collaboration tools
- [Contact Center & CX](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/contact-center-cx/): Customer experience and contact center solutions
## About Verizon
- [About Us](https://www.verizon.com/about/): General information about Verizon's mission, values, and company overview
- [Investor Relations](https://www.verizon.com/about/investors): Financial information, earnings reports, and investor resources
- [News](https://www.verizon.com/about/news/): Latest news, press releases, and company announcements
- [Careers](https://www.verizon.com/about/careers): Job opportunities, company culture, and career development at Verizon
- [Innovation Labs](https://www.verizon.com/about/our-company/innovation-labs): Information about Verizon's technology innovation and research initiatives
- [Responsibility](https://www.verizon.com/about/responsibility): Corporate social responsibility, sustainability, and community impact initiatives
## Support
- [Business Support](https://www.verizon.com/business/support/): Comprehensive support resources for business customers
- [Check Network Status](https://www.verizon.com/support/check-network-status/): Comprehensive support to get information on the network status based on the location
- [Billing and Payment Support](https://www.verizon.com/support/billing-and-payments/): Comprehensive support resources for Mobile billing and payments
- [Troubleshooting devices](https://www.verizon.com/support/devices/): Smartphones and FWA devices troubleshooting
- [Consumer Contact Info](https://www.verizon.com/digital/nsa/nos/ui/ngd/contactus): Contact Information related to Account and billing, Technical support, Sales for consumer and Fios flows.
- [Business Contact Info](https://www.verizon.com/business/contact-us/): Contact information and methods to reach Verizon business support
- [Network Support](https://www.verizon.com/support/network/): Network status, coverage maps, and connectivity troubleshooting
- [Community Forums](https://community.verizon.com/): Customer community for peer support and discussions
## social
- [verizon support](https://x.com/verizonsupport): verizon support page in x platform
- [facebook](https://www.facebook.com/verizon): verizon page in facebook platform
- [twitter](https://x.com/verizon): verizon page in twitter platform
- [x](https://x.com/verizon): verizon page in x platform
- [youtube](https://www.youtube.com/user/verizon): verizon channel in youtube platform
- [instagram](https://www.instagram.com/verizon/): verizon page in instagram platform
- [tiktok](https://www.tiktok.com/@verizon): verizon page in tiktok platform
## Optional
- [Site Map](https://www.verizon.com/business/site-map/): Complete sitemap for business section navigation
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.verizon.com/about/privacy/): Detailed privacy policy and data handling practices
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.verizon.com/about/terms-conditions/overview): Service terms, conditions, and legal agreements
- [Accessibility](https://www.verizon.com/accessibility/): Accessibility features and resources for customers with disabilities

## Sitemap
